advisor_identified: Associate professor of history at Memorial University of Newfoundland, specializing in modern European social history and the history of medicine; supervisor of the listed Stockholm dissertation.

doctorate.title: Rural industry, disease, and the struggle for health in nineteenth-century Prussia and Sweden: a comparative study of Iserlohn County and the Sundsvall area

evidence.says: Memorial History identifies Stephan Curtis as an associate professor and lists his Ph.D. from Carnegie Mellon University in 2000.
The library catalogue attributes the dissertation recorded above to Stephan Michael Curtis and identifies it as a doctoral dissertation at Carnegie-Mellon University, 2000.
The spring 2025 convocation programme, printed page 59, lists Stephan Curtis as supervisor of Stewart Bratke Lawrence in History, with the Stockholm dissertation matching the student entry.

notes: The advisor’s faculty biography and the independent library catalogue agree on institution and year. The linked title is a shortened rendering of the catalogue title, which spells out nineteenth-century and specifies Iserlohn County.
